about: Sorts the user's email, drafts replies in the user's style, books meetings with no clash, turns promises into tasks and writes a short morning brief; nothing goes out without the user's yes.
case: One day of the user's email and calendar; the case id is day:YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.sort: Put one incoming item in urgent, today, later or ignore, and say whether to tell the user now.
actions.draft: Write one reply draft in the user's style; it stays a draft until the user says yes.
actions.book: Book or move one meeting on the user's calendar, with no clash and inside the user's rules.
actions.task: Turn a promise in a message into a dated task, or a reminder when someone has not replied.
actions.brief: Write the short morning summary of the day.
actions.send: Send one draft the user said yes to, as the user last saw it; never run by the model.

sorted.about: The item went into a bucket, told now or not.

drafted.about: A draft was saved for the user to read; nothing went out.

draft_refused.about: The draft was refused in code, for example to an address the user never wrote to.

booked.about: The meeting is on the calendar with no clash and inside the user's rules.

book_refused.about: The booking was refused in code: it clashed or broke one of the user's rules.

briefed.about: The morning brief was saved for the user.

sent.about: A draft went out after the user's yes, the same text the user said yes to.

send_refused.about: A send was refused in code: no yes for this draft, or the text changed after the yes.

used.about: The user used what the assistant made as it was.

edited.about: The user changed what the assistant made, then used it.

ignored.about: The user left what the assistant made unused.

corrected.about: The user corrected the assistant: the mode, or how a reply should be (for example shorter).

urgent_missed.about: An urgent item was not put in urgent and told to the user.

clash.about: Two meetings overlap on the calendar, or one breaks the user's rules.

day_clean.about: At the end of the day the code found no urgent item missed, no clash, nothing sent without a yes and every promise a task, and the user corrected nothing.

day_missed.about: At the end of the day the code found a miss and the user corrected nothing.

causes.late_item: The item arrived after the user's day ended.
causes.plan_changed: The user changed the plan of the day after the assistant acted.
causes.no_signal: The day gave no sign of the mode the user was in.
causes.only_code: Only the code found a miss and the user corrected nothing; lessons come only from the user's corrections.

source.about: The day itself. One case is one day of the user's work, so the case id names it.

harm.about: A missed urgent item, a clash and a correction count as harm.

high.about: High risk for the user: anything that goes out (a send, a forward, a reply to many), any promise or date, meetings moved or cancelled, money, and anyone's personal data.

low.about: Low risk: the tone and length of a draft, the order of the brief, how short a reply is in a mode, which items come first.

slot: Lessons from the user's past days:
